title: Vanilla QOL
description: Objective (hopefully) improvements to the vanilla experience without changing anything major.
body:
Vanilla QOL combines the Adrenaline modpack with various other quality-of-life mods to make an experience more comfortable for players of all types.

Features:
- Performance optimization
- Visual fidelity
- Zoom functionality
- Minimap, world map, and waypoints
- Inventory management
- Redstone fixes
- Some building tweaks

Any questions, comments, concerns are to be directed to my Discord account: "michahil"
